other_conditions: Active scientist with a record of outstanding performance evident from the award of the S.S. Bhatnagar prize and/or fellowship of science academies (including engineering, agriculture, and medicine).
Must be in service at the time of nomination.
Must be an Indian national working in institutions/universities in India.
Must not be receiving any other fellowship or research grant from government sources.
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹25,000 plus a research grant of ₹15 lakhs per annum and an overhead of ₹1 lakh per annum for the host institute.
documents_required: Research contribution PDF (last 5 years) – max 10 MB
